title: Cat and Dog: Where Is Cat?
summary: Dog comes to visit Cat, but she isn't home. He looks for her everywhere, and then he sees something peeking out from the leaves of the tree.
pages: Dog goes to Cat's house. The door is open. The door of the house is open.
Dog goes in the door. Now Dog is inside the house. Now Dog is inside Cat's house.
But Cat is not at home. Oh! Oh! Where is Cat?
Dog looks on the bed, but Cat is not on the bed.
Dog looks under the table, but Cat is not under the table.
Dog looks in front of the chair, but Cat is not in front of the chair.
Dog looks behind the door, but Cat is not behind the door.
Then Dog sees a ladder. He sees a ladder next to the tree. The ladder is broken.
Dog looks up. Dog looks up at the tree. Dog looks up at the leaves of the tree.
Dog sees a leg. There is a leg in the leaves. And Dog sees an arm. There is an arm in the leaves. Then Dog sees a face...
Dog sees Cat's face! Cat is sitting in the tree. Cat is sitting in the tree with a ball. Cat cannot get down from the tree. Cat cannot get down from the tree because the ladder is broken.
Dog helps Cat. Dog helps Cat get down from the tree.
When Cat is down, she gives Dog a big kiss.
